subject: English
passage: Logs of user interactions captured during beta testing, ______ elevated rates of navigation errors in interface regions associated with ambiguous menu labeling.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: navigation-error rates reveal that the most experienced beta testers recorded in clickstream files show
choices.B: the most experienced beta testers navigating complex interface prototypes have clickstream files that reveal
choices.C: clickstream files reveal that while navigating complex interface prototypes, the most experienced beta testers show
choices.D: behaviors of experienced beta testers navigating complex prototypes reveal clickstream files with

explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the noun phrase "clickstream files" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "Logs of user interactions captured during beta testing." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that clickstream files—and not another noun in the sentence—are the logs of user interactions captured during beta testing.
